description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'MidiPortSelector' that manages MIDI port selection via a UI Spinner component, handling device addition, removal, and status changes.

classes.name: MidiPortSelector
classes.description: An abstract class for selecting MIDI ports using a Spinner UI component, handling device callbacks and port status changes.

methods.name: MidiPortSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing MIDI device callback, populating the spinner with available MIDI ports.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Resets the spinner selection to no port.

methods.name: getInfoPortCount
methods.description: Returns the number of ports (input or output) for a given MIDI device info.

methods.name: onDeviceAdded
methods.description: Handles addition of a MIDI device, adding its ports to the adapter.

methods.name: onDeviceRemoved
methods.description: Handles removal of a MIDI device, removing its ports from the adapter.

methods.name: onDeviceStatusChanged
methods.description: Updates port availability based on port busy/free status changes.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Abstract method to handle user selection of a MIDI port.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Calls onClose to clean up resources.
